name: odoo-ai-agents
description: Odoo AI workforce toolkit - 50 skills + 22 specialist agents + 8 workflow commands across engineering, sales, marketing, strategy, setup, visual UI testing, and automated multi-module git integration. Pairs with the odoo-semantic-mcp server for indexed-codebase grounding (auto-installed). Includes browser-automation agents for Odoo UI review and automated setup.

speech_api_key.title: Speech endpoint key
speech_api_key.description: Sent as the bearer value to the narration speech endpoint declared by /odoo-ai-agents:odoo-setup voice (speech.toml auth = bearer). Leave empty for an endpoint that needs none.

youtube_client_id.title: YouTube OAuth client id
youtube_client_id.description: The Desktop OAuth client of your Google Cloud project with the YouTube Data API enabled; 75-youtube.sh consent stores it for you from the downloaded client JSON.

youtube_client_secret.title: YouTube OAuth client secret
youtube_client_secret.description: The same client's secret; stored by 75-youtube.sh consent.

youtube_refresh_token_docs.title: YouTube refresh token - docs channel
youtube_refresh_token_docs.description: Refresh token (scope youtube.force-ssl) of the account owning the channel in youtube.toml slot docs; obtained once by 75-youtube.sh consent --channel <purpose>.

youtube_refresh_token_marketing.title: YouTube refresh token - marketing channel
youtube_refresh_token_marketing.description: Same, for the channel in slot marketing (optional).

youtube_refresh_token_third.title: YouTube refresh token - third channel
youtube_refresh_token_third.description: Same, for a third channel in slot third (optional).
